responsibility: This target header defines driver self-spec rules for MIPS ELF configurations that choose between o32 and o64 ABIs based on architecture and gp width. It ensures a -mips option is present, infers the default ABI from ISA level or register size, strips redundant -mfp64 for o64 multilib selection, and then applies the shared base MIPS driver specs, so it primarily controls ABI-selection logic for oabi-style ELF toolchains.
